title: Rust announce codec missing 193-byte announce / 100-byte app-data caps
description: Spec 05-routing.md §9.2 (R-05-068): 'the announce MUST NOT exceed 193 bytes and App Data MUST NOT exceed 100 bytes' (254-byte signed link body budget minus 4-byte link header, 8-byte signer id, 48-byte link sig). Divergent: C enforces (lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/include/lichen/announce.h:30-32 MAX_LEN 193U/MAX_APP_DATA_LEN 100, parse reject announce.c:261) and Python enforces (python/src/lichen/announce/messages.py:16-17, from_bytes rejects >193) with tests; Rust lichen-core/src/announce.rs from_bytes accepts app_data up to u16::MAX (AppDataTooLong only at >65535, announce.rs:152) and no 193 constant exists; node RX only has an incidental 256-byte transcript buffer bound (lichen-node/src/announce.rs:162). Cross-implementation parity divergence: Rust admits announces C/Python reject. Fix: add MAX_ANNOUNCE_WIRE_LENGTH=193 / MAX_APP_DATA=100 to lichen-core codec + vector.
close_reason: Rust parity with C/Python announce caps (spec 05-routing 9.2): added MAX_ANNOUNCE_WIRE_LENGTH=193 and MAX_ANNOUNCE_APP_DATA=100 to lichen-core/src/announce.rs; from_bytes rejects wire>193 (new AnnounceError::TooLong) post-dispatch-strip; write_announce_signed_data and AnnounceBuilder::write_to reject app_data>100 (AppDataTooLong). Shared vector file test/vectors/announce_length_caps.json (93/193/194-byte cases) consumed by new rust/lichen-core/tests/announce_length_caps_vectors.rs and python/tests/test_vectors.py::test_announce_length_caps_vector. Gates: cargo test lichen-core+lichen-node all ok, clippy -D warnings clean, rustfmt clean, pytest test_vectors 773 passed. 3x codereview (Kimi K3): correctness pass — vector description arithmetic fixed inline (doc-only); scheduler error-mapping finding filed as worker6-e7vg; R-ID matrix anchoring noted on parent b7z9. Security pass — PASS. Edge-cases pass — dispatch-prefix leniency documented in from_bytes doc comment, adjudication filed as worker6-y3s5. Findings filed per protocol, not recursively fixed; second review round skipped as remaining changes were doc-only.
